scope: Actual component handlers and booking functions executed with controlled hooks/storage/DOM adapters. Not a browser walkthrough or visual QA. Download click is observed, and generated HTML is inspected separately.

checks.name: All five cities have two relevant bilingual proposed tours
Complete English booking, selected details and duplicate-confirm protection
Ticket survives refresh, retains details and starts a file download
Editing a date updates the same ticket and survives reload
Cancelling updates the stored ticket and prevents further editing
Arabic booking draft survives refresh and completes in Arabic
Storage failure preserves form details and does not issue a ticket
Past or forged dates, invalid slots, bad guest counts and excluded tours cannot be booked
Ticket export escapes visitor text and preserves prototype disclosure
Explore entry opens city tours without opening the conversation card
Privacy Clear data deletes prototype tickets and booking drafts
Religious data, AI backend and source gates unchanged from 0.6.5
